title: Site Engineer
abstract: Take ownership of exciting commercial projects. Work hand-in-hand with a Project Manager and fast track your progression to a Project Engineer role
bullets: Work on exciting high profile commercial projects
content_text:
- Work on exciting high profile commercial projects
 - Fast track to Project Engineer
 - Competitive salary package on offer
ABOUT THE COMPANY.
Work for one of Canberra's most prestigious and well-known building companies. With specialisation in delivering commercial projects valued $40M to $100M, this company has delivered some of the city's most iconic buildings. Boasting strong culture, excellent subcontractor relationships, a well regarded safety culture, and known for mentoring some of the best talent in the industry, this company is offering a fantastic opportunity for an eager Site Engineer with aspirations to grow into Project Engineering and Project Management at a fast tracked timeframe. 
ABOUT THE POSITION. 
As Site Engineer, you’ll work alongside an experienced team to deliver a major commercial project. You’ll be involved in every stage of the build - ensuring safety, quality, and coordination across all trades and services. This role provides broad project exposure and the chance to further develop your technical and leadership skills.
DUTIES.
 - Implement and manage construction plans, schedules, and budgets on-site
 - Oversee day-to-day operations, including quality control, safety compliance, and workflow
 - Collaborate with the Project Manager to resolve issues and ensure projects objectives are met
 - Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors
 - Prepare and maintain accurate project documentation
 SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE.  - Tertiary or Trade Qualification in a building related discipline is preferable
 - Proven record of monitoring, managing and complying with WHS and Quality Assurance processes
 - Showcase a strong track record of stability with previous employers
 CULTURE. 
You’ll be part of an energetic and motivated team that fosters a culture of positivity and excellence. Within this supportive environment, you’ll be encouraged to enhance your technical knowledge and deliver outcomes that meet the highest professional benchmarks.
BENEFITS.
 - Excellent career progression opportunity to PE and PM in the future
 - Diverse, exciting projects to boost your CV portfolio
 - Strong project pipeline for a promising career
 - Structured training opportunities to accelerate your career
 HOW TO APPLY.
Click “Apply for this job” or contact Sarah Flynn on (02) 9231 4999 for a confidential discussion.
